## The problem

What are you trying to do that Laras cannot do today? Describe the situation, not just the feature.

## The idea

What should Laras do? Keep it to one idea per issue.

## Alternatives you considered

Is there another way to get the same result, inside or outside the app?

## Notes

- Scope is frozen after milestone M4, so new ideas are considered for post-v1 unless they fix something broken.
- Login, cloud sync, telemetry, ads, and a server are out of scope by design. Requests for them will be closed.
- Anything that needs the Spotify API is permanently out of scope.
